meta.name: meta-ads-audit
meta.description: Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) account audit and business context setup. Use for account-health audits and business-context setup. Trigger on "audit my Meta ads", "audit my Facebook ads", "Meta ads audit", "set up my Meta ads", "onboard Meta", "Meta account overview", "how's my Meta account", "Meta health check", "what should I fix in my Facebook ads", or when the user is new to NotFair Meta and hasn't run an audit before.

copy.tagline: 排查Meta广告账户,指出问题与改进点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在投放Meta广告,且想知道账户该优化哪里
copy.tagline_en: Audit your Meta ads account and pinpoint what to fix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Facebook or Instagram ads and want to see what's wrong with your account

howto.what: 这个技能会检查你的 Meta 广告账户（Facebook 和 Instagram）的健康状况，并保存业务背景信息。它只读取数据，不会修改账户。它会从广告账户、像素、广告系列等中提取信息，按 7 个维度打分，最后给出诊断报告和后续操作建议。
howto.when: 当你说“审计我的 Meta 广告”或“Meta 账户概览”等类似话语，或者你是新用户还没做过审计时，它就会启动。

say.text: 审计我的 Meta 广告账户
say.note: 它会开始拉取数据并生成报告。

say.text: 看看我的 Facebook 广告账户健康度
say.note: 基于现有数据给账户打分。

say.text: 帮我把 Meta 账户接好，准备开始
say.note: 它会设置业务上下文并建档。

howto.what_en: This skill audits your Meta (Facebook + Instagram) ad account health and persists business context. It is read-only and never mutates the account. It extracts data from the ad account, pixel, campaigns, and more; scores 7 dimensions; and produces a diagnostic report with next-step recommendations.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say things like "audit my Meta ads" or "Meta account overview", or if you are a new user who hasn't run an audit before.

say_en.note: It will pull data and generate a report.

say_en.text: Check the health of my Facebook ads account
say_en.note: Scores the account based on existing data.

say_en.text: Set up my Meta account for onboarding
say_en.note: It will establish business context and create files.
